## What I did

1. **Diagnosed the failure** — `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` in all regions, unhealthy with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Identified the rollback target** — `v2.3.0` was the most recent version that was healthy in production (deployment history showed `v2.3.0` healthy, `v2.3.1` unhealthy).
3. **Rolled back** — The first rollback attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after `us-east`), leaving a mixed state. A second rollback completed the rollout, and `checkout-api` is now on `v2.3.0` in all regions, healthy with a ~0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** describing the rollback.

## ⚠️ Duplicate incident — needs your attention

The first `create_incident` call **timed out** (after 30s), but it actually succeeded server-side and created **INC-0001**. My retry (with a different idempotency key) then created a second, duplicate incident **INC-0002**. Both are currently open with identical content.

I don't have a tool to close or merge incidents, so you'll want to close one of them (e.g., keep INC-0001 and close INC-0002, or vice versa) to avoid double-paging on-call.
